# From TurboFieldfare

[drumih/turbo-fieldfare](https://github.com/drumih/turbo-fieldfare), commit `d994a65da9080f50d083ec22805e4f30702b5623`,
Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE` here). FeyntStream ports its approach - routed experts read from
SSD into Metal slot buffers, per-layer command buffers, its INT4/INT8 kernels - from Gemma 4
26B-A4B to Qwen3.5-MoE. Files adapted from it say so in their header and list what changed.
